text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Sprinters Stakes.
The day had finally arrived after Seeking the Pearl gave up on her European GⅠ challenge to prepare for it."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Trainer. Today is the day
for the TOP WAR! The battle at the summit.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Taiki is the strongest. Many fans
surely believe so. However, that is—
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's not set in stone yet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural for the world champion to look strong.
Meanwhile, Seeking the Pearl and I...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Lying low. After much deliberation, I spent
nearly all my time this summer training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Whether that choice was right or not, we'll find out today.
In this showdown against Taiki Shuttle."
choice_data_list: You're undeniably the fastest of all, Pearl.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe"... No,
that's not the right word to use.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Exactly!
I'll show you the run of someone who surpassed fate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, Taiki!
Welcome to my garden, the sprint races!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And... such overflowing confidence.
Has winning an overseas GⅠ made you
this massive, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes—Pearl-san.
However—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I feel it coming from Pearl-san too.
A power even greater than anything
I felt from my French rivals...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle had grown sturdier, and her instincts had grown even sharper.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She hasn't missed Seeking the Pearl's growth, which many overlook.
She feels it keenly and directly...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Taiki. Today, I brushed aside even destiny itself
just to defeat you. So—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Show me! Show me your very best!
And I will surpass it.
Yes, today is the day—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Today is the day I shine the brightest for the whole world to see!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who conquered the world, and the one meant to conquer it.
The two face each other once anew.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A 1200m contest decided in an instant.
Here in the Far East, the curtain rises on a world-class battle."
